composition_subtypes.role: Sort coupons by value descending, then greedily select the largest set of distinct numbers satisfying the beautiful array condition

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy choice of most valuable coupons after sorting, limited by a mathematical condition on the maximum distinct count
payload.rationale: Sorting is inherent to the greedy strategy; the condition check is a simple linear scan without additional algorithms, so no true multi-mechanism composition
